rules.title: Los Angeles Just Cause for Eviction Ordinance (JCO)
rules.requirement: Landlords may not terminate covered tenancies without just cause. At-fault reasons (e.g., nonpayment, uncured lease violation, nuisance, illegal use) and no-fault reasons (owner/family move-in, demolition or removal from market, government order, etc.) are listed; no-fault evictions require relocation assistance.
rules.coverage_text: Most residential properties in the City of Los Angeles not regulated by the RSO (buildings newer than October 1, 1978, and single-family dwellings); applies once the tenant has lived in the unit at least six months or the original lease has expired, whichever comes first.
rules.exemptions_text: Transient hotels, licensed care facilities, fraternity or sorority houses, owner's roommate, cooperatives under certain circumstances, some non-profit facilities for the homeless or short-term substance abuse treatment centers, some properties owned by HACLA or the government.

exemption_tests.description: Some non-profit facilities for the homeless or short-term treatment centers for substance abuse
Some properties owned by HACLA or the government

rules.citation: Los Angeles Just Cause for Eviction Ordinance (JCO)
rules.quoted_span: It prohibits terminations of tenancies without just cause and requires relocation assistance for no-fault evictions.
rules.key_value: Just cause required; relocation assistance for no-fault evictions
rules.ambiguity_note: Page is a summary; says JCO 'can apply' to buildings newer than October 1, 1978 and to single-family dwellings.

rules.title: Nonpayment of rent eviction threshold (Fair Market Rent)
rules.requirement: Landlords may not evict a tenant for falling behind in rent unless the amount owed exceeds the Fair Market Rent for the unit's bedroom size.
rules.coverage_text: All RSO and JCO rental units in the City of Los Angeles.
rules.citation: Los Angeles Just Cause for Eviction Ordinance (JCO)
rules.quoted_span: Effective March 27, 2023, landlords may not evict a tenant who falls behind in rent unless the tenant owes an amount higher than the Fair Market Rent (FMR).
rules.key_value: Rent owed must exceed Fair Market Rent for bedroom size
